change: Bounded ephemeral private LTX capture; authoritative log/image proofs unchanged.
method_limits: Sequential candidate-first comparison on a shared host; no causal guarantee from throughput alone.
Success latency percentiles exclude refused/ambiguous requests; errors remain separately reported.
Operation histogram quantiles are bucket bounds. Metrics bracket the timed process and include small launch/exit intervals.
Boundary archive lag is not a steady-state time series.
A postfailure reconciliation never changes a failed timed result into a pass.

candidate.label: candidate
candidate.method: Candidate-first frozen runtime comparison: bounded ephemeral LTX handoff versus integrated 86297e7. Fresh persistent host node volumes through Colima virtiofs and external RustFS on the 224-GiB VM disk. Cold benchmark VM restart per cohort. Three nodes, 1 vCPU and 3 GiB each, 500 leaders and 1000 followers each, 1500 groups/3 voters, four SQL workers with 16 slots each (64 total), four archive retained-cut slots. Two 180-second windows at 24 writers. Same load AST. Quorum acknowledgements, exact 4500 replica values and 1500 archive positions; timed mutations never retry. Shared-host activity recorded; existing cumulative metrics are sampled outside each timed load process; this task performs no builds or profiling during timing. Compare sustained throughput and p99 without converting reconciliation into a timed pass.
